longBio: Northern Disconnection is a band on a mission to bring the great Bay Area tradition of improvisational americana in new directions and to new generations. The creative forces behind Northern Disconnection take inspiration from the coastal forests of their Northern California home, and strive to transport their audience away from the stress of always-online modern life for a few hours each show. The band's sonic melting pot incorporates sounds from psychedelic rock, folk, blues, and jazz. Northern Disconnection's sets feature original songs as well as their own take on the music of various influences and inspirations, including the Grateful Dead, Bob Dylan, Chuck Prophet, and Eric Clapton.

The band is also the host artist of G-Fest, a benefit concert in Petaluma for the Georgia Riley Pellkofer Foundation that raised over $100,000 across 2025 and 2026. At G-Fest 2026, Northern Disconnection opened for Radshap Allstars, featuring Scott Law (Phil Lesh & Friends), Brian Rashap and Danny Eisenberg (the Mother Hips) and Danny Luehring (Danny's Live Dead). Other stops include Kilowatt in San Francisco, The Big Easy in Petaluma and The Forestville Club, and the band has appeared on KRCB 104.9 FM's The Morning Show with Brian Griffith alongside Brian Rashap.
